name: 재율

sessions.title: Not allowed to use a phone

tips.동사·시제: prefer는 일반동사: I prefer (I'm prefer ❌), 과거 부정은 didn't prefer. used to + 동사원형. 과거 이야기는 끝까지 과거형(went, sold).
tips.관사·전치사: go to + 장소, listen to music, near + 장소(nearby는 부사). in the morning, the internet.
tips.문장 구조: 목적은 to + 동사원형: I came here to study English.
tips.주어-동사: one of + 복수명사: one of my favourite apps.
tips.발음·철자: 빨리 말하면 실수가 나와요. 살짝 천천히, 또박또박!

focus.1: 조금 천천히, 또박또박 말하기! Part 2 템플릿 암기.
focus.3: favourite activity, food, animal, exercise 답은 미리 정해 두기.
focus.4: Part 1 주제별로 딱 맞는 표현 공부하기.
focus.6: Part 3는 더 straightforward하게: 답 → 이유 → 예시.

compare: near + 장소: near my house · nearby 부사·형용사: a café nearby, a nearby café
목적은 to + 동사원형: I came here to study

cards.en: There's a café near my house.
cards.gram: near + 장소(전치사): near my house. nearby는 부사·형용사: There's a café nearby. / a nearby café.

cards.ko: 어릴 때 저는 공원에 자주 가곤 했어요.
cards.en: I used to go to the park a lot when I was a kid.
cards.gram: used to + 동사원형. used to went ❌

cards.en: I prefer happy music.
cards.gram: prefer는 일반동사라 앞에 I'm을 붙이지 않아요: I prefer.

cards.en: I like to go to the park.
cards.gram: 장소로 갈 때는 go to + 장소. go park ❌

cards.en: I went to Japan last year.
cards.gram: 과거 이야기는 끝까지 과거형: went. 빨리 말하다 go/went가 섞이지 않게!

cards.ko: 그 집은 제 조건에 다 맞아요.
cards.en: That house ticks all the boxes.
cards.gram: tick all the boxes = 원하는 조건을 다 충족하다.

cards.en: We were in the same batch.
cards.gram: batch = 동기, 기수. She is my batchmate.

cards.en: That moment felt surreal.
cards.gram: surreal = 꿈같은, 비현실적인.

cards.en: I'm not a picky eater.
cards.gram: picky eater = 편식하는 사람.

cards.en: We hit it off right away.
cards.gram: hit it off = (처음 만나서) 바로 죽이 잘 맞다.

cards.en: I was working out, but I fell off the wagon.
cards.gram: fall off the wagon = 끊었던 나쁜 습관으로 돌아가다.

cards.en: I can't be bothered to cook today.
cards.gram: I can't be bothered to + 동사 = ~하기 귀찮다.

cards.en: My neighbourhood is quiet, and my neighbours are friendly.
cards.gram: neighbourhood = 동네, neighbour = 이웃 사람.

cards.en: He sold his company last year.
cards.gram: sell의 과거는 sold. 과거 이야기에 sells ❌

cards.en: I'm really proud of him.
cards.gram: be proud of + 사람 = ~가 자랑스럽다.

cards.en: It's ten to eight.
It's a 9-minute drive from my home.
cards.gram: It's a 9-minute drive. 숫자-minute이 형용사라 minute 단수.

cards.ko: 저는 집에 있는 걸 좋아하는 집순이·집돌이예요.
cards.en: I'm a homebody.
cards.gram: homebody = 집에 있는 걸 좋아하는 사람.

cards.en: I drink coffee in the morning.
cards.gram: in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening. the를 빼먹지 않기. at night만 the 없음.

cards.ko: 저는 현지 음식을 먹어 보는 걸 좋아해요.
cards.en: I love trying authentic food.
cards.gram: authentic food = 현지 그대로의 음식, 정통 음식.

cards.en: I need to brush up on my English.
cards.gram: brush up on ~ = (잊은 실력을) 다시 감 잡다, 다듬다.

cards.en: Give it a go!
cards.gram: give it a go = 한번 해 보다.

cards.en: I get car sick.
cards.gram: get car sick = 차멀미를 하다.

cards.ko: 어릴 때 저는 운동을 별로 좋아하지 않았어요.
cards.en: I didn't like sports when I was a child.
cards.gram: 일반동사 과거 부정은 didn't + 동사원형. wasn't prefer ❌ → didn't prefer.

cards.en: I listen to music when I work out.
cards.gram: listen to + 대상. to를 빼먹지 않기!

cards.en: Price-wise, it's quite reasonable.
cards.gram: 명사 + -wise = ~ 면에서: price-wise, location-wise.

cards.en: Water is a precious resource.
cards.gram: resource = 자원, 물자.

cards.en: Good teachers are irreplaceable.
cards.gram: irreplaceable = 대체할 수 없는. Technology Part 3에 좋아요.

cards.en: He has a strong ego.
cards.gram: strong ego / strong pride = 자존심이 세다.

cards.en: From my perspective, experience is more important.
cards.gram: From my perspective, = 제 관점에서는. Part 3 답변 시작에 좋아요.

cards.en: My teacher told me off.
cards.gram: tell someone off = 야단치다(과거 told off).

cards.en: I came here to study English.
cards.gram: 목적은 to + 동사원형: came here to study. for studying보다 자연스러워요.
cards.mine: I came here for studying English.

cards.ko: 저는 그 질문에 바로 답할게요. 저는 동의해요.
cards.en: To answer directly, I agree.
cards.gram: Part 3는 돌려 말하지 말고 straightforward하게: 먼저 답 → 이유 → 예시.

cards.ko: 그건 제가 가장 좋아하는 앱 중 하나예요.
cards.en: It's one of my favourite apps.
cards.gram: one of the most ~ / one of my favourite + 복수명사.

cards.ko: 배경을 조금 말씀드리자면, 저는 그때 대학생이었어요.
cards.en: To give you some background, I was a university student at the time.
cards.gram: To give you some background, = 배경을 말씀드리자면. Part 2 시작에 좋아요.

cards.en: The internet suddenly stopped working.
cards.gram: the internet처럼 the를 붙여요. the environment, the government도 마찬가지.

part3.topic: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others
qs: Do you think people travel more nowadays than in the past?
What kinds of places do people in your country like to visit?
Do young people and older people prefer different travel destinations?
Is it better to travel alone or with other people? Why?

part3.topic: Describe a person you know who has a successful business
qs: Do you think small businesses are important for the economy?
Why do some businesses become successful while others fail?
Do you think young people should be encouraged to start their own businesses? Why or why not?
Do you think customer service is important for a successful business? Why or why not?

part3.topic: Describe a perfect job you would like to have in the future
qs: What factors do people usually consider when choosing a career?
Do you think young people today change jobs more often than in the past? Why or why not?
Is it more important to earn a high salary or to enjoy your job? Why?
How do you think technology will change the workplace in the future?

part3.topic: Describe an occasion when you were not allowed to use your mobile phone
qs: How has the widespread use of smartphones changed the way people communicate?
Should there be more places where mobile phones are not allowed? Why?
Do you think children should be allowed to use mobile phones at school? Why or why not?
Why do some people find it difficult to put their phones away?

part3.topic: Describe a live sports event you watched and liked
qs: What qualities do successful athletes usually have?
Do you think children should be encouraged to play sports from a young age? Why?
Do you think hosting major sporting events is beneficial for a country? Why or why not?
Do you think watching sports can bring people together?
Do you think sports will become more or less popular in the future?
What can children learn from playing team sports?

part3.topic: Describe a piece of technology that you would like to own
qs: How has technology changed people's daily lives in the past 20 years?
Should schools encourage students to use more technology in the classroom? Why or why not?
Why do some people always want to buy the latest technology?
Do you think people rely too much on technology nowadays?
Do you think AI will have a positive or negative impact on society?
Can technology replace teachers in the future?

part3.topic: Describe a time when you gave advice to others
qs: Why do some people ignore advice from others?
Who gives better advice, older people or younger people?
Why do some people prefer solving problems on their own instead of asking for advice?
Is it important to listen to different opinions before making a decision?
Whose advice is more influential for young people, their parents' or their friends'?

part3.topic: Describe a challenging technological problem you faced
qs: What kinds of technological problems do people commonly face nowadays?
Are older people more likely to struggle with technology than younger people?
Do technological problems affect people's productivity at work or school? How?
What are the disadvantages of relying too much on technology in daily life?
Will artificial intelligence help reduce technological problems in the future?
